baseline.scope: v6 quality-first intake and authoring contract; v5 weak-model behavior remains compatibility evidence only.
observed_strengths: DeckPlan rejected raw geometry and produced native editable PowerPoint objects.
The renderer already had deterministic layout, theme, package, and COM quality gates.
observed_gaps: Ordinary models had to author facts, titles, story structure, and semantic slides in one DeckPlan response.
No FactStore, BriefPlan, NarrativePlan, explicit art-direction choice, or BrandSpec authority existed.
Weak-model failures included schema near-misses, unsupported free text, repeated forms, invented claims, and missing required beats.
Quality evidence began after compilation and did not merge input/narrative/compiler findings.
